tool.name: Forex Tester Online
tool.description: Forex Tester Online is a browser backtester for forex and other retail markets. You replay tick data across several charts and can test both manual and automated ideas. A free demo is offered.
features: Tick-level historical data and synced multi-chart replay
Economic calendar and project history that does not expire on the annual plans
The Pro plan adds a larger symbol list, an exit optimizer and prop-firm challenge practice
Free demo, with no card required to start

plans.name: Starter, annual
plans.detail: Promo price, shown as $13.25 per month. Non-promo price on the same page: $199 per year. The page says the promo price stays locked on renewal.

plans.name: Pro, annual
plans.detail: Promo price, shown as $19.92 per month. Non-promo price on the same page: $299 per year.

tool.pricing_note: Annual USD prices from the official site on 11 Oct 2026. Monthly and lifetime options are also offered there. Taxes may apply.
